question: Four words are given, out of which only one word is spelt correctly. Choose the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is "**KNOWLEDGE.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the spelling and meaning of the given words:
 
• **"Knowledge" means a noun that refers to information, understanding, or skills acquired through experience or education. **(ज्ञान)&
